title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the New England-style charm of Granville, Ohio, just steps from the Denison University campus gates.

cards.title: The Broadway Pub
cards.subtitle: East Broadway Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this local tavern for elevated pub fare and a popular outdoor patio located in the heart of the village's historic district.
cards.short_summary: A central village tavern known for its burgers and outdoor seating on East Broadway.
cards.evidence_claim: The Broadway Pub is a Granville partner where students can use Big Red Bucks for lunch and dinner.
cards.access_notes: Open daily for lunch and dinner; check official site for specific kitchen hours.

cards.title: Day Y Noche
cards.subtitle: North Prospect Street
cards.notes: Enjoy modern Mexican cuisine and fresh guacamole at this bright, stylish restaurant just off the main village intersection.
cards.short_summary: A modern Mexican restaurant on North Prospect Street popular with the Denison community.
cards.evidence_claim: Day Y Noche is listed as an off-campus participant for Denison's Big Red Bucks program.
cards.access_notes: Located on North Prospect Street; serves lunch and dinner.

cards.title: Whit's Frozen Custard
cards.subtitle: East Broadway Corridor
cards.notes: Stop by the original location of this famous custard shop to try the weekly flavor or a signature 'Whitser' treat.
cards.short_summary: The founding location of the national frozen custard chain, situated on East Broadway.
cards.evidence_claim: Whit's Frozen Custard is a quintessential Granville stop mentioned in Denison's official town guide.
cards.source_title: About | Granville, Columbus & more - Denison University
cards.access_notes: Walkable from campus; open daily with seasonal hours.

cards.title: Readers' Garden Book Store
cards.subtitle: East Broadway Corridor
cards.notes: Browse a curated selection of titles at this independent bookstore located in the heart of the village's shopping district.
cards.short_summary: An independent bookstore serving the Granville and Denison community on East Broadway.
cards.evidence_claim: Readers' Garden is an independent bookstore in the heart of Granville, home of Denison University.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Saturday; check website for holiday hours.

cards.title: Elm's Pizza Parlor
cards.subtitle: North Prospect Street
cards.notes: Grab a classic hand-tossed pizza or sub at this local staple that has served the community since 1975.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing local pizzeria on North Prospect Street known for its nostalgic vibe.
cards.evidence_claim: Elm's Pizza Parlor is a local tradition in Granville serving classic hand-tossed pizzas.
cards.source_title: Things to Do in Granville, Ohio | Dining & Shopping Guide
cards.access_notes: Located one block from the main village intersection.

cards.title: The Granville Inn
cards.subtitle: East Broadway Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this historic landmark for upscale dining or to admire the stone architecture of a village centerpiece built in 1924.
cards.short_summary: A historic inn and restaurant owned by Denison University, located on East Broadway.
cards.evidence_claim: The Granville Inn is a historic landmark offering upscale American fare and is owned by Denison University.
cards.access_notes: Open daily for dining; reservations recommended for the main dining room.

cards.title: Granville Milling Co.
cards.subtitle: South Main Street
cards.notes: Explore this historic country store for unique gifts and pet supplies, representing the town's agricultural roots.
cards.short_summary: A historic milling company and country store located on South Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Milling Company and Country Store is listed as a retailer on South Main Street in Granville.
cards.access_notes: Located south of the main downtown intersection.

cards.title: Alfie's Granville
cards.subtitle: East Broadway Corridor
cards.notes: Experience a British-inspired cafe serving savory scones and traditional UK treats in a cozy village setting.
cards.short_summary: A British-style bakery and cafe located on East Broadway.
cards.evidence_claim: Alfie's is a British-inspired café and bakery serving coffee and traditional UK treats on East Broadway.
cards.source_title: Things to Do in Granville, Ohio | Dining & Shopping Guide
cards.access_notes: Open for breakfast and afternoon tea; check social media for daily specials.

cards.title: The Lot Beer Co.
cards.subtitle: North Prospect Street
cards.notes: Dine on wood-fired pizzas in a spacious hall that frequently hosts live music events for the local community.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant and brewery on North Prospect Street featuring wood-fired pizza and live music.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lot Beer Co. features wood-fired pizzas and live music events in a spacious atmosphere.
cards.source_title: Things to Do in Granville, Ohio | Dining & Shopping Guide
cards.access_notes: All ages welcome for dining; check schedule for live music performances.

cards.title: Green Velvet
cards.subtitle: East Broadway Corridor
cards.notes: Shop for unique jewelry, home goods, and gifts at this boutique that captures the village's artisan spirit.
cards.short_summary: A boutique gift and jewelry shop located on East Broadway in downtown Granville.
cards.evidence_claim: Green Velvet is a featured retailer in Granville offering gifts, jewelry, and home items.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; located near the intersection of Broadway and Main.
